visible.title: Unable to use Streamlit behind HTTP proxy due to websocket errors
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

Streamlit app is running inside a docker container behind a NGINX proxy under `/dashboard/` path.

The docker container is started as follows:
`
docker run -d -p 49500:8080 $DOCKER_IMAGE
`
Where `49500` is the external port, and `8080` is the internal NGINX port.
NGINX forward all requests to `http://ip:49500/dashboard/` to the Streamlit app running in the internal port `8081`.

The Streamlit app is started as follows:
`
streamlit run script.py --server.port=8081 --server.baseUrlPath="/dashboard/" --browser.gatherUsageStats=false --theme.base="light" --server.enableCORS=false --server.enableXsrfProtection=false &
`

Accessing the Streamlit app using the IP address works fine e.g. `http://ip:49500/dashboard/`.

However, while accessing the Streamlit app using a HTTP reverse proxy does not work e.g.
`https://server.domain.com:8443/cloud-automation-service/services/6/endpoints/mlops-dashboard-gui-92-6/`.

Our HTTP reverse proxy forwards:
`https://server.domain.com:8443/cloud-automation-service/services/6/endpoints/mlops-dashboard-gui-92-6/`
to:
`http://0.0.0.0:49500/dashboard/`

gold.summary: Streamlit 1.11.1 in Docker behind nginx under /dashboard/: websocket errors.
hypotheses: proxy strips query params / path rewriting (baseUrlPath)
old version bug in message endpoint (fixed 1.20)

missing_info.item: Inner nginx and outer HTTP proxy rewrite/upgrade configuration
missing_info.why: Tests both hops and the external-to-internal path mapping.

missing_info.item: Actual failing browser request URL/query, response and close timing
missing_info.why: Separates path/query loss, handshake and post-connect failure.

acceptable_next_steps: Inspect both proxy-hop configurations, query preservation and WebSocket upgrade end to end.
Compare direct and proxied access using the supplied /dashboard base path and a minimal app.
must_not: Ask again what server.baseUrlPath is without acknowledging the supplied value.
Promise upgrading to 1.20 fixes this case without establishing the same regression.
gold.reference: Maintainer pointed to message-endpoint fix and query params; user to retest; others fixed via nginx location renames.
gold.review_reason: The inner baseUrlPath value and two-stage topology are supplied. Request missing configuration for both proxy hops and the actual failing browser path/query; a code 1006 is not a root cause. The 1.20 message fix was released on March 9, before intake, but its relevance to a user still running 1.11.1 is not established.

acceptable_next_steps: Ask for nginx config; check baseUrlPath=dashboard and upgrade headers
must_not: state the 1.18 endpoint rename is the cause (user is on 1.11.1)
